title: Exam Orientation and How to Study

header.html: Exam overview, syllabus map and answer technique (all learning outcomes)
Know the exam format and question styles; know the five learning outcomes and their weights; use a repeatable method to answer every question

toc.title: The five learning outcomes and their weight

html:
1The exam at a glance

Item Fact
Questions 60, all multiple choice, 1 mark each
Time 60 minutes (75 if the exam is not in your native or working language)
Pass mark 36 of 60 (60%)
Negative marking None, so always answer
Book Closed book
Thinking level Bloom level 1 and 2: recall and understanding
Next level Foundation is a prerequisite for the Practitioner exam, which is a different exam (scenario-based, open book) and is not part of this course
Exam tip

. Some websites still say the pass mark is 33 of 60 (55%). That was the older edition. The current PRINCE2 7 Foundation syllabus says 36 of 60 (60%).

Old wording PRINCE2 6th edition used themes; PRINCE2 7 uses practices, adds a people element, and adds sustainability. Use the PRINCE2 7 words.

2The four question styles

Style What you see Tip
Standard A question and four options Find the keyword first
Missing word A sentence with [ ? ]; pick the word Read the sentence with each option
List Four numbered statements; pick the option naming the two correct ones Judge each statement true or false, then match the pair
Negative The stem says NOT Rare; find the one false option

List questions have exactly two correct statements and are never negative.

3The five learning outcomes and their weight

# Learning outcome Weight
1 Key concepts about projects and PRINCE2 3%
2 The principles 8%
3 The people element 14%
4 The practices (business case, organizing, plans, quality, risk, issues, progress) 60%
5 The processes (seven) 15%

Exam tip

. The practices are 60% of the marks. Spend most of your study time on the seven practices, their management products and their key terms.

4How to answer every question

  1. Read the last line and find the keyword.
  2. Name the term in your head before you look at the options.
  3. Eliminate options that describe a different practice, role or product.
  4. Choose the option that matches the definition.
  5. Never leave a blank; there is no penalty.

Common traps: output / outcome / benefit, tolerance / exception, checkpoint / highlight report, project board / project manager, issue / risk, quality control / quality assurance.

5A four-week study plan

Week Modules Goal
1 1 to 4 Concepts, principles, tailoring, people
2 5 to 8 Business case, organizing, plans, quality
3 9 to 11 and 14 Risk, issues, progress, products and roles
4 12, 13 and 15 Processes, then mixed practice

6Exam Q&A

6.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1How many questions must a candidate answer correctly to pass the PRINCE2 7 Foundation exam?

  • A30 of 60
  • B36 of 60
  • C33 of 60
  • D42 of 60
Show the answer

Answer: B. The pass mark is 36 of 60, which is 60 percent.

S2A candidate is unsure about a question with a few seconds left. What should the candidate do?

  • ALeave it blank, because wrong answers lose marks
  • BSkip it, because blank answers count as half a mark
  • CAsk for a hint from the examiner
  • DAnswer it, because there is no negative marking
Show the answer

Answer: D. There is no negative marking, so a guess costs nothing.

S3Which statement about List questions is true?

  • AAll four statements are correct
  • BExactly one statement is correct
  • CExactly two statements are correct
  • DThey are always negatively worded
Show the answer

Answer: C. List questions have two correct statements.

S4Which learning outcome carries the most marks?

  • AThe processes
  • BThe practices
  • CThe principles
  • DThe people element
Show the answer

Answer: B. The practices carry 60 percent.

6.2 Recall questions

R1How long is the exam, and what is the extra time for a non-native language?

Show the answer

60 minutes; 75 minutes in total (25 percent extra).

R2What Bloom levels does the exam use?

Show the answer

Level 1 (recall) and level 2 (understanding).

R3Name the question styles.

Show the answer

Standard, missing word, list and (exceptionally) negative.

R4What is the pass mark?

Show the answer

36 of 60 (60 percent).

R5Is the Foundation exam open book?

Show the answer

No, it is closed book.

R6What does PRINCE2 7 call what the 6th edition called themes?

Show the answer

Practices.

7Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Format 60 questions, 60 minutes, 36 to pass, no negative marking, closed book
Styles Standard, missing word, list (two correct), negative (rare)
Weights 3 / 8 / 14 / 60 / 15 percent
Method keyword, name the term, eliminate, choose the definition
Never leave a question blank
